title: Coprimality conjecture for reciprocal subsum numerator and denominator
statement:
Let $n\geq 1$, and let $\mathrm{num}(n,x)$ and $\mathrm{den}(n,x)$ be the reduced numerator and denominator associated with the sum of reciprocals of subsum polynomials over partitions of $n$. **Coprimality conjecture.** For every $n\geq 1$, 
$$
\gcd\bigl(\mathrm{num}(n,x),\mathrm{den}(n,x)\bigr)=1\:.
$$
 The source describes this as a weaker claim for which partial results have been obtained; its general validity remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10512

Status: **open** according to the source (as of May 2026). “In Section , we discuss open questions for sums of reciprocals of subsum polynomials defined on restricted sets of partitions.”
source_name: Cristina Ballantine, George Beck, Brooke Feigon and Kathrin Maurischat, “Reciprocals of Subsum Polynomials”, arXiv:2605.10512 (2026).
